sloka: एवमप्यतिनिद्रस्तु यदा नैव प्रबुध्यते ।शापस्य वशमापन्नस्ततः क्रुद्धा निशाचराः ।महाक्रोधसमाविष्टाः सर्वे भीमपराक्रमाः ।। ६.६०.५० ।।।।
transliteration: evamapyatinidrastu yadā naiva prabudhyate ।śāpasya vaśamāpannastataḥ kruddhā niśācarāḥ ।mahākrodhasamāviṣṭāḥ sarve bhīmaparākramāḥ ।। 6.60.50 ।।।।

translations.english: While some were beating the drums, some shouted at the pitch of their voice, some started pulling his hair and some bit his ears.
